items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: the singer, I think it was Maul Rainey.

ctx.x: Or Jimmy Blythe made some. Did you ever work with Jimmy Blythe, a piano player?

Well, let's see. Maybe that was when O'Brien was with him, because I can't remember who played. O'Brien is the only one I can remember in the band. So it might have been Blythe, because he played piano, didn't he? Yeah. It might have been the pianist. Yeah, it might have been Blythe. Because the only one I can remember is Jimmy O'Brien, and the singer, I think it was Maul Rainey.
